definition: Just coming into existence and displaying early signs of functional development or RNA transcription.
etymology: From Latin nascens, present participle of nasci ('to be born').
manuscriptExample: Nascent RNA sequencing (PRO-seq) captured immediate transcriptional responses following heat shock induction.
conferenceExample: The referee requested metabolic labeling assays to specifically quantify nascent protein synthesis.

definition: The process of adjusting raw experimental measurements against baseline standards or internal housekeeping controls.
manuscriptExample: Quantification of qPCR signal required double normalization against GAPDH and beta-actin housekeeping transcripts.
conferenceExample: The handling editor requested clarification regarding total protein normalization across Western blot lanes.
